method: COMPILED FROM 2 SOURCES. S1: QUOTED from Aktaşoğlu EÖ, Özdemir HB, Özmen MC, İnci A, Okur İ, Ezgü FS, Tümer L (Gazi University, Ankara), Orphanet Journal of Rare Diseases 21:104 'Gyrate atrophy of the choroid and retina: a tertiary center experience' (published 16 February 2026), 13 claims; LICENCE: CC BY 4.0 (read at Europe PMC fullTextXML <license> element for PMC13011296). S2: PARAPHRASED AND HASH-ANCHORED from Balfoort BM, Van den Broeck F, Boon CJF, et al., GACR 'Bird's Eye View' Consortium (Amsterdam UMC), Journal of Inherited Metabolic Disease 48(1):e12842 (doi 10.1002/jimd.12842) 'Novel Insights Into Gyrate Atrophy of the Choroid and Retina (GACR): A Cohort Study' (published 6 January 2025), 12 claims; LICENCE: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (read at Europe PMC fullTextXML <license> element for PMC11703598). Verify each source separately: verify.py --source <file> --only-source S<n>. Edition 2.0 adds a larger cohort (S2: 27 patients, Amsterdam UMC registry, 2025). Searches of Europe PMC and PubMed (gyrate atrophy, ornithine aminotransferase, hyperornithinaemia with guideline, consensus, recommendations, review, cohort; 2012-2026) found no guideline, consensus statement or GeneReviews chapter; the reviews found (Eur J Ophthalmol 2022, Mol Genet Metab 2021 treatment review, Arch Soc Esp Oftalmol 2024) are not open access. S2 is licensed CC BY-NC-ND, so its claims are paraphrased and hash-anchored.

claims.claim: **GACR is a rare autosomal recessive disorder of amino acid metabolism** caused by OAT gene variants; incidence is about 1:1,500,000.
claims.source_text: is a rare autosomal recessive disorder of amino acid metabolism caused by the pathogenic variants of the OAT gene []. The incidence of the disease is 1:1,500,000
claims.locator: Aktaşoğlu EÖ, Özdemir HB, Özmen MC, İnci A, Okur İ, Ezgü FS, Tümer L (Gazi University, Ankara), Orphanet Journal of Rare Diseases 21:104, 'Gyrate atrophy of the choroid and retina: a tertiary center experience', published 16 February 2026, https://doi.org/10.1186/s13023-026-04265-x, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **OAT deficiency causes slowly progressive chorioretinal degeneration and blindness.** Myopia and night blindness are the usual presenting symptoms; newborns may instead present with hyperammonaemia.
claims.source_text: A deficiency of OAT causes a slowly progressive chorioretinal degeneration that results in blindness []. Myopia and night blindness are common symptoms that patients present with [], but newborns may present with hyperammonemia and related symptoms
claims.locator: Aktaşoğlu EÖ, Özdemir HB, Özmen MC, İnci A, Okur İ, Ezgü FS, Tümer L (Gazi University, Ankara), Orphanet Journal of Rare Diseases 21:104, 'Gyrate atrophy of the choroid and retina: a tertiary center experience', published 16 February 2026, https://doi.org/10.1186/s13023-026-04265-x, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Cognition may also be affected,** through secondary creatine deficiency caused by high ornithine; cataracts and vision loss also occur.
claims.source_text: In addition to ophthalmological symptoms such as night blindness, myopia, cataracts, and vision loss in patients [], cognitive functions may be impaired due to secondary creatine deficiency due to hyperornithinemia
claims.locator: Aktaşoğlu EÖ, Özdemir HB, Özmen MC, İnci A, Okur İ, Ezgü FS, Tümer L (Gazi University, Ankara), Orphanet Journal of Rare Diseases 21:104, 'Gyrate atrophy of the choroid and retina: a tertiary center experience', published 16 February 2026, https://doi.org/10.1186/s13023-026-04265-x, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **The fundus shows sharply demarcated mid-peripheral chorioretinal atrophy spreading toward the posterior pole;** OCT often shows outer retinal thinning and cystoid macular oedema.
claims.source_text: Retinal findings included sharply demarcated areas of chorioretinal atrophy predominantly in the midperiphery, progressing toward the posterior pole with well-preserved macular islands in earlier stages. … On OCT, marked outer retinal thinning and cystoid macular edema (CME) were observed in five patients
claims.locator: Aktaşoğlu EÖ, Özdemir HB, Özmen MC, İnci A, Okur İ, Ezgü FS, Tümer L (Gazi University, Ankara), Orphanet Journal of Rare Diseases 21:104, 'Gyrate atrophy of the choroid and retina: a tertiary center experience', published 16 February 2026, https://doi.org/10.1186/s13023-026-04265-x, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **In the larger cohort, eye symptoms began at a mean age of 10 years,** most often as poor vision from myopia or as night blindness. Twelve patients were found by targeted testing once a sibling had been diagnosed.
claims.locator: Balfoort BM, Van den Broeck F, Boon CJF, et al., GACR 'Bird's Eye View' Consortium (Amsterdam UMC), Journal of Inherited Metabolic Disease 48(1):e12842 (doi 10.1002/jimd.12842), 'Novel Insights Into Gyrate Atrophy of the Choroid and Retina (GACR): A Cohort Study', published 6 January 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11703598/, retrieved 2026-09-24

claims.claim: **High plasma ornithine is the biochemical hallmark:** every patient had it at diagnosis. Screen siblings; the youngest here (15 months) was found by family screening.
claims.source_text: All patients had high plasma ornithine levels at the time of diagnosis. … The earliest diagnosed patient was 15 months old. He was diagnosed in the family screening conducted after his brother (P4) was diagnosed.
claims.locator: Aktaşoğlu EÖ, Özdemir HB, Özmen MC, İnci A, Okur İ, Ezgü FS, Tümer L (Gazi University, Ankara), Orphanet Journal of Rare Diseases 21:104, 'Gyrate atrophy of the choroid and retina: a tertiary center experience', published 16 February 2026, https://doi.org/10.1186/s13023-026-04265-x, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **ERG is usually markedly reduced or extinguished at diagnosis;** use it as a diagnostic and baseline test, not to judge short-term treatment effect.
claims.source_text: ERG responses in patients with gyrate atrophy are typically markedly reduced or extinguished at diagnosis, reflecting severe dysfunction of both rod and cone photoreceptors … ERG primarily serves as a diagnostic and baseline functional assessment tool rather than a sensitive marker for short-term therapeutic efficacy in GACR.
claims.locator: Aktaşoğlu EÖ, Özdemir HB, Özmen MC, İnci A, Okur İ, Ezgü FS, Tümer L (Gazi University, Ankara), Orphanet Journal of Rare Diseases 21:104, 'Gyrate atrophy of the choroid and retina: a tertiary center experience', published 16 February 2026, https://doi.org/10.1186/s13023-026-04265-x, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **At diagnosis, S2 patients averaged a plasma ornithine of 735.7 µmol/L (range 341–1207), against a laboratory reference of 27–98.**
claims.locator: Balfoort BM, Van den Broeck F, Boon CJF, et al., GACR 'Bird's Eye View' Consortium (Amsterdam UMC), Journal of Inherited Metabolic Disease 48(1):e12842 (doi 10.1002/jimd.12842), 'Novel Insights Into Gyrate Atrophy of the Choroid and Retina (GACR): A Cohort Study', published 6 January 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11703598/, retrieved 2026-09-24

claims.claim: ⚠️ **In the newborn period ornithine can be normal or low,** because the enzyme runs in reverse, and babies can present with hyperammonaemia; a neonatal proline/citrulline ratio above 32 followed by persistently high ornithine counts as diagnostic.
claims.locator: Balfoort BM, Van den Broeck F, Boon CJF, et al., GACR 'Bird's Eye View' Consortium (Amsterdam UMC), Journal of Inherited Metabolic Disease 48(1):e12842 (doi 10.1002/jimd.12842), 'Novel Insights Into Gyrate Atrophy of the Choroid and Retina (GACR): A Cohort Study', published 6 January 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11703598/, retrieved 2026-09-24

claims.claim: **Look for cerebral creatine deficiency with MR spectroscopy:** it was present in fifteen of the 20 patients with data. Plasma creatine can be normal or high on supplements while brain creatine stays low.
claims.locator: Balfoort BM, Van den Broeck F, Boon CJF, et al., GACR 'Bird's Eye View' Consortium (Amsterdam UMC), Journal of Inherited Metabolic Disease 48(1):e12842 (doi 10.1002/jimd.12842), 'Novel Insights Into Gyrate Atrophy of the Choroid and Retina (GACR): A Cohort Study', published 6 January 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11703598/, retrieved 2026-09-24

claims.claim: **There is no satisfactory treatment and no consensus;** an arginine-restricted diet with pyridoxine, lysine, proline or creatine may help.
claims.source_text: There is no satisfactory treatment, but an arginine-restricted diet in combination with pyridoxine, lysine, proline, or creatine supplementation may be beneficial … its poorly understood pathophysiology leaves treatment options unclear, and there remains no consensus on treatment.
claims.locator: Aktaşoğlu EÖ, Özdemir HB, Özmen MC, İnci A, Okur İ, Ezgü FS, Tümer L (Gazi University, Ankara), Orphanet Journal of Rare Diseases 21:104, 'Gyrate atrophy of the choroid and retina: a tertiary center experience', published 16 February 2026, https://doi.org/10.1186/s13023-026-04265-x, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Test pyridoxine (vitamin B6) responsiveness first,** before starting the diet, because OAT depends on pyridoxal phosphate. About 30% of patients respond in one review.
claims.source_text: Since the OAT enzyme is pyridoxal phosphate-dependent, patients were first assessed for responsiveness to B6 before beginning the arginine-restricted diet. … In the review by Balfoort et al. [], 30% of patients were found to be pyridoxine-responsive.
claims.locator: Aktaşoğlu EÖ, Özdemir HB, Özmen MC, İnci A, Okur İ, Ezgü FS, Tümer L (Gazi University, Ankara), Orphanet Journal of Rare Diseases 21:104, 'Gyrate atrophy of the choroid and retina: a tertiary center experience', published 16 February 2026, https://doi.org/10.1186/s13023-026-04265-x, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Arginine-restricted diet:** restrict natural protein and supplement with low-protein formulas. It is the most commonly used treatment, but whether protein restriction slows progression is not well studied.
claims.source_text: All patients were started on an arginine-restricted diet. The amount of protein the patients consumed was restricted, and their diets were supplemented with low-protein formulas. … The most commonly used treatment method is an arginine-restricted diet []. In a study by Hayasaka et al., OAT-deficient mice fed an arginine-restricted diet showed better ophthalmological function than those fed a normal diet []. On the other hand, there is limited research on whether a protein-restricted diet improves disease progression
claims.locator: Aktaşoğlu EÖ, Özdemir HB, Özmen MC, İnci A, Okur İ, Ezgü FS, Tümer L (Gazi University, Ankara), Orphanet Journal of Rare Diseases 21:104, 'Gyrate atrophy of the choroid and retina: a tertiary center experience', published 16 February 2026, https://doi.org/10.1186/s13023-026-04265-x, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Add creatine monohydrate for secondary creatine deficiency;** oral L-lysine lowered plasma ornithine in 5 pyridoxine-unresponsive patients.
claims.source_text: Creatine monohydrate was added to the treatment of 5/7 patients due to secondary creatine deficiency … the addition of oral L-lysine to the treatment of 5 GACR patients who did not respond to pyridoxine resulted in a decrease in plasma ornithine levels and an increase in urinary ornithine excretion
claims.locator: Aktaşoğlu EÖ, Özdemir HB, Özmen MC, İnci A, Okur İ, Ezgü FS, Tümer L (Gazi University, Ankara), Orphanet Journal of Rare Diseases 21:104, 'Gyrate atrophy of the choroid and retina: a tertiary center experience', published 16 February 2026, https://doi.org/10.1186/s13023-026-04265-x, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Start the diet early:** the four patients who kept more than 10° of central visual field had all begun protein restriction before age 10, and the only patient free of atrophic lesions had started ornithine-lowering treatment in the first year of life.
claims.locator: Balfoort BM, Van den Broeck F, Boon CJF, et al., GACR 'Bird's Eye View' Consortium (Amsterdam UMC), Journal of Inherited Metabolic Disease 48(1):e12842 (doi 10.1002/jimd.12842), 'Novel Insights Into Gyrate Atrophy of the Choroid and Retina (GACR): A Cohort Study', published 6 January 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11703598/, retrieved 2026-09-24

claims.claim: **Arginine-free essential amino acid supplements are added when natural protein intake is below dietary reference values** (the role of the PBS-listed formulas). Patients had kept to the diet for a median of 8 years, and nine reported struggling with it at some point.
claims.locator: Balfoort BM, Van den Broeck F, Boon CJF, et al., GACR 'Bird's Eye View' Consortium (Amsterdam UMC), Journal of Inherited Metabolic Disease 48(1):e12842 (doi 10.1002/jimd.12842), 'Novel Insights Into Gyrate Atrophy of the Choroid and Retina (GACR): A Cohort Study', published 6 January 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11703598/, retrieved 2026-09-24

claims.claim: **Plasma ornithine usually stays high on treatment:** below 100 µmol/L only in the newborn period and in one patient on an extremely strict diet. After treatment began it fell in 12 of 27 patients and rose in 10 of 27.
claims.locator: Balfoort BM, Van den Broeck F, Boon CJF, et al., GACR 'Bird's Eye View' Consortium (Amsterdam UMC), Journal of Inherited Metabolic Disease 48(1):e12842 (doi 10.1002/jimd.12842), 'Novel Insights Into Gyrate Atrophy of the Choroid and Retina (GACR): A Cohort Study', published 6 January 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11703598/, retrieved 2026-09-24

claims.claim: **Ornithine climbs with age, by about 8.1 µmol/L a year, independent of protein intake,** so in adults a rising level is not on its own proof of poor adherence, even though intake and reported adherence both affect it.
claims.locator: Balfoort BM, Van den Broeck F, Boon CJF, et al., GACR 'Bird's Eye View' Consortium (Amsterdam UMC), Journal of Inherited Metabolic Disease 48(1):e12842 (doi 10.1002/jimd.12842), 'Novel Insights Into Gyrate Atrophy of the Choroid and Retina (GACR): A Cohort Study', published 6 January 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11703598/, retrieved 2026-09-24

claims.claim: **Pyridoxine was given at a mean of 260 mg a day (range 50–600 mg); three patients responded in vivo,** two with measured ornithine falls of 24% and 36%. Response probably depends on the OAT variants.
claims.locator: Balfoort BM, Van den Broeck F, Boon CJF, et al., GACR 'Bird's Eye View' Consortium (Amsterdam UMC), Journal of Inherited Metabolic Disease 48(1):e12842 (doi 10.1002/jimd.12842), 'Novel Insights Into Gyrate Atrophy of the Choroid and Retina (GACR): A Cohort Study', published 6 January 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11703598/, retrieved 2026-09-24

claims.claim: **L-lysine at 2 to 15 g a day showed no clear effect on ornithine in this cohort, and gastrointestinal side effects made three patients stop;** loss of appetite from those effects risks catabolism and a rise in ornithine.
claims.locator: Balfoort BM, Van den Broeck F, Boon CJF, et al., GACR 'Bird's Eye View' Consortium (Amsterdam UMC), Journal of Inherited Metabolic Disease 48(1):e12842 (doi 10.1002/jimd.12842), 'Novel Insights Into Gyrate Atrophy of the Choroid and Retina (GACR): A Cohort Study', published 6 January 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11703598/, retrieved 2026-09-24

claims.claim: **Cystoid macular oedema is treated with topical NSAIDs (e.g. nepafenac), often with a carbonic anhydrase inhibitor (acetazolamide, brinzolamide);** responses in GACR are inconsistent and were mostly unsatisfactory here.
claims.source_text: Topical nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), such as nepafenac, and carbonic anhydrase inhibitors (CAIs), such as brinzolamide, are used in ophthalmology to treat cystoid macular edema (CME). … Five of seven patients in our cohort received topical nepafenac, but responses were generally unsatisfactory. … while CAIs, such as acetazolamide and brinzolamide, may reduce CME in retinitis pigmentosa and similar IRDs, their effectiveness in gyrate atrophy of the choroid and retina (GACR) is less conclusive
claims.locator: Aktaşoğlu EÖ, Özdemir HB, Özmen MC, İnci A, Okur İ, Ezgü FS, Tümer L (Gazi University, Ankara), Orphanet Journal of Rare Diseases 21:104, 'Gyrate atrophy of the choroid and retina: a tertiary center experience', published 16 February 2026, https://doi.org/10.1186/s13023-026-04265-x, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Subtenon platelet-rich plasma and topical CoQ10/vitamin E TPGS are experimental** and cannot be recommended; neither gave a lasting benefit.
claims.source_text: To date, no clinical studies have specifically evaluated the use of subtenon PRP in GACR. In the present study, subtenon PRP was attempted experimentally; however, no significant anatomical or functional improvement in macular edema was observed. … Further controlled clinical studies are required before its use can be recommended in GACR.
claims.locator: Aktaşoğlu EÖ, Özdemir HB, Özmen MC, İnci A, Okur İ, Ezgü FS, Tümer L (Gazi University, Ankara), Orphanet Journal of Rare Diseases 21:104, 'Gyrate atrophy of the choroid and retina: a tertiary center experience', published 16 February 2026, https://doi.org/10.1186/s13023-026-04265-x, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Diagnose early and follow jointly in metabolic and ophthalmology clinics;** patients here were reviewed every 3-6 months. Diet and medicine adherence was poor, and metabolic follow-up fell away as vision worsened.
claims.source_text: it is essential to diagnose GACR as early as possible to initiate an arginine-restricted diet and manage other metabolic parameters, in addition to ophthalmologic treatment. … Patients came in for check-ups every 3-6 months … It was observed that as the patients' ophthalmological symptoms worsened, their metabolic check-ups decreased, and two patients even discontinued follow-up.
claims.locator: Aktaşoğlu EÖ, Özdemir HB, Özmen MC, İnci A, Okur İ, Ezgü FS, Tümer L (Gazi University, Ankara), Orphanet Journal of Rare Diseases 21:104, 'Gyrate atrophy of the choroid and retina: a tertiary center experience', published 16 February 2026, https://doi.org/10.1186/s13023-026-04265-x, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Watch muscle mass:** four patients aged 28 to 57 met criteria for sarcopenia, and 9 of 12 measured had a low fat-free mass index; creatine deficiency or reduced mobility from poor vision may contribute.
claims.locator: Balfoort BM, Van den Broeck F, Boon CJF, et al., GACR 'Bird's Eye View' Consortium (Amsterdam UMC), Journal of Inherited Metabolic Disease 48(1):e12842 (doi 10.1002/jimd.12842), 'Novel Insights Into Gyrate Atrophy of the Choroid and Retina (GACR): A Cohort Study', published 6 January 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11703598/, retrieved 2026-09-24

claims.claim: **The authors argue for newborn screening:** ornithine does not work as a newborn marker, but the citrulline/proline ratio could, and starting treatment in the first decade may pay off long term.
claims.locator: Balfoort BM, Van den Broeck F, Boon CJF, et al., GACR 'Bird's Eye View' Consortium (Amsterdam UMC), Journal of Inherited Metabolic Disease 48(1):e12842 (doi 10.1002/jimd.12842), 'Novel Insights Into Gyrate Atrophy of the Choroid and Retina (GACR): A Cohort Study', published 6 January 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11703598/, retrieved 2026-09-24
